solution_summary: Stratagem used Gemini Enterprise to streamline operations and scale consulting services with increased efficiency and cost savings. As Stratagem’s reputation grew, so did the administrative complexity of managing a diverse portfolio. The team found themselves navigating a fragmented landscape of tools for project management, financial tracking, and client communications. This manual work often distracted from the company’s core mission: helping retailers solve common industry challenges like inventory management and precise, on-time delivery. “Our strategy is to build a control tower that sits in the middle of all the systems our clients use to run their businesses,” says Ashwin Katuri, co-founder and partner at Stratagem.
